BF6_Extended_Terrain.changes: The Toolbox that comes with it is the same as the other tools' current one, which lists Bot Navigation. The Toolbox's installer no longer refuses to update tools or add new ones after High Poly has updated itself.

history.1.2.0: Open Extended Terrain in the Toolbox using the shared season style. Read terrain indexes and terrain packs from the Toolbox repository.
history.1.2.1: Comes with the Toolbox, which now installs with the plugin itself, with or without BF6 Home. It lists every plugin with its installed version, shows when an update is available and what changed before you update, and can add the other released plugins.
history.2.0.0: Reads the terrain and the distant landscape from your Battlefield 6 install through High Poly, so it now needs High Poly installed, like Player Controller. Nothing is downloaded any more and nothing is saved into your map. A "Remove old downloaded terrain" button clears what earlier versions placed and downloaded.

BF6_Godot_Bot_Navigation.changes: First release, as a beta. See where bots can go on the open map, and what they will do on yours: the navigation rebuilt under your placed objects as you edit, where bots walk, crouch and crawl, low ceilings that can trap them, platforms too small for navigation, what your spawners cannot reach, and the route between two selected nodes. Needs High Poly.

history.1.0.1: The Toolbox that comes with it lists the new tools: High Poly 3.0.0, Player Controller, Soundboard and Early Bird, and Game Mode Setup and Extended Terrain 2.0.0.

BF6_High_Poly_Godot_Plugin.changes: Reads bot navigation for the new Bot Navigation tool, shares built geometry across maps and game updates, plays sounds at the game's own Master and Effects volume, and fixes Object Library icons, furniture cut-outs and prop paint after the October game update. The Toolbox's installer no longer refuses to update tools or add new ones after High Poly has updated itself.

history.3.0.0: Comes with the Toolbox. No longer ships any tables built from game data: everything is read from your install. Updates from 2.10 through a bridge release, and the updater now replaces libraries the editor has loaded instead of skipping them.

BF6_Soundboard.changes: The game's own Master and Effects volume sliders, so sounds play as loud as they are in the game. The range sliders never filter the list down to nothing. The Toolbox's installer no longer refuses to update tools or add new ones after High Poly has updated itself.

history.1.0.0: First release. Every Portal sound by its exact SDK name, with search, filters and waveforms; play it from your install, copy the line that plays it, or place it in the map. Needs High Poly.
